text:
sophie: Seeing SCIM provisioning failing since we flipped the SSO app from SAML->OIDC, Okta is returning 403 on POST /Users. Anyone else? Logs show KMS decrypt errors when the provisioning worker tries to read the SCIM token.

 dave: Can you paste the log lines? 403 could be IdP side but KMS errors mean our service can't decrypt the stored secret. @infra-bot check key policy for scim/kms-key.

 sophie: Log snippet:
```
ERROR provisioning.worker: failed to decrypt secret: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/redwood-scim-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abcd-1234
POST https://scim.redwood.dev/Users 403
```

 kevin: That role was adjusted during the RBAC cleanup last week — we removed a broad kms:* grant. Quick check: does the role have kms:Decrypt on that key (and is the key policy allowing the role)? The KMS key policy needs the principal explicitly or allow via IAM.

 ana: Also confirm the SCIM token in Secrets Manager got re-encrypted with the same CMK after rotation. If the token was rotated while key was replaced, old ciphertext won't decrypt.

 dave: Steps I recommend:
1) infra-bot: re-add kms:Decrypt for role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/redwood-scim-role to the CMK key policy and IAM inline policy.
2) If that still fails, rotate the SCIM token: generate new token in Okta app, update AWS Secrets Manager secret `redwood/scim/token`, then trigger a secrets sync job.
3) Check Okta ASYNC provisioning logs for detailed error codes (provisioning API -> Last Push Status).

 infra-bot: I pushed a policy change to allow kms:Decrypt for the role on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abcd-1234 and staged a secrets-sync run.

 sophie: After the policy was added provisioning resumed. Okta shows 200s and users created. Two follow-ups: 1) add an audit log alert for 'scim_provisioning.failure' to the console; 2) add a runbook entry for 'SSO provider switch -> re-encrypt SCIM token' so future SAML->OIDC flips don't break.

 kevin: I'll open a short PR to the RBAC playbook to include the KMS principal verification step. Also adding an audit rule: when KMS AccessDenied appears for service role, page eng-security.

 ana: Filing a vuln triage note: the RBAC change didn't follow change review — assigning to dave for post-mortem. Recommend automated test to decrypt secrets in staging after IAM changes.

 sophie: thanks all :heart: marking as resolved once the PR merges.
